Create a minimal ocx.toml in the current directory

Usage: ocx init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --consent
          Record a consent stamp (the default unless OCX_NO_CONSENT is set)
          
          The stamp is what lets a shell prompt in this directory apply the project's tools and environment; without one the project is inert. It is the same stamp `ocx add`, `ocx lock`, `ocx pull` and `ocx exec` write as a side effect, and `ocx shell revoke` takes back. Pass this to stamp anyway where OCX_NO_CONSENT is set.
          
          https://ocx.sh/docs/in-depth/shell-integration

      --no-consent
          Run without consenting to this project's shell activation
          
          Consent later with `ocx shell allow`, or by running any mutating command in the directory. OCX_NO_CONSENT=1 is the same choice for every command at once.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
